verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developers.llamaindex.ai, and the docs include a dedicated 'for-agents' section. It offers an official docs MCP server with search_docs (BM25), grep_docs (regex), and read_doc tools so agents can search and read the documentation directly. Missing for 10: per-page markdown docs variants (the .md probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
